meta.name: learn
meta.description: Distill a reusable skill from anything — a directory, a URL, pasted notes, or what you just did together — or refine an existing skill with new learnings. Use when the user says '/learn', 'learn this', 'turn this into a skill', 'capture this workflow', 'make a skill from <source>', or 'improve/update the <name> skill'. Produces or updates a .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md authored to NanoClaw's skill guidelines. (This CREATES or REFINES a skill from a source; it does not install existing skills from a registry.)

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从任何来源提炼或改进可复用的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把操作流程固化为可复用的技能
copy.tagline_en: Distill or refine a reusable skill from any source
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn workflows into reusable skills

howto.what: 装上后,当你把一段做法、网址或笔记沉淀成技能时,Claude 会整理出一份 SKILL.md 说明书,存到 .claude/skills/ 目录;它只用现有的读、搜、抓取、写文件工具,没有额外引擎。已有技能则就地更新,不覆盖。
howto.when: 当你说「/learn」「learn this」「turn this into a skill」等指令,或要求把某段工作流、网址、笔记变成技能,或要求改进/更新某个已有技能时触发。

say.text: /learn 这个项目目录,整理成技能
say.note: 会读取目录结构并生成 SKILL.md。

say.text: /learn 这个网页,做成一份技能
say.note: 会抓取页面并提炼出操作步骤。
会把刚才的流程总结成技能。

howto.what_en: Once installed, when you ask to turn a workflow, URL, or notes into a skill, Claude distills it into a SKILL.md file under .claude/skills/ using only existing tools (Read, Grep, Glob, WebFetch, Write) — no separate engine. Existing skills are refined in place, not overwritten.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say '/learn', 'learn this', 'turn this into a skill', and similar commands, or ask to make a skill from a source, or to improve/update an existing skill.

say_en.note: Reads the tree and writes a SKILL.md.
Fetches the page and distills the steps.
Turns this conversation's workflow into a skill.
